notes: This is a thematic collection rather than a single titled picture book, so no single named hero character exists. The hero slot uses a generic spring image. All 11 fringe words are drawn from classic spring themes (weather, nature, animals, plants) that typically appear across spring-themed books in early childhood and SPED classrooms. If this board is paired with a specific spring book (e.g. 'The Tiny Seed' by Eric Carle or 'Fletcher and the Springtime Blossoms'), consider replacing the hero image and adjusting fringe words to match that specific text.
